segments.text: What's your best fighting chance against cancer? It's actually muscle mass. So I know a lot of
people out there when they get a diagnosis of cancer or when they have cancer in their family,
they like to focus on a lot of different things that they can try to be proactive about. So here's
your number one tip from me on how you can best survive cancer if you get it, which we all know
as humans our chance of getting cancer in our lifetime is actually super high. So if you're
going to have to go through cancer treatment, the best possible thing that you can have before you
start that journey is good muscle mass. So we know that chemotherapy drugs, and most of us honestly
fear the chemo more than we fear the cancer, but chemotherapy drugs deplete skeletal muscle. And if
you don't start with much, if you don't start off with a good muscle mass, then you're already starting
your tank on zero. And so not only can weight lifting and weight training and building muscle
mass help you in your day to day life, but it could end up being the thing that saves
your life if you ever have to get cancer treatment.
So hit the weights, hit the gym, we're not concentrating on being skinny girls anymore.
What we need to be is strong and healthy, okay?
